title: rPAL-seq: pipeline for glycoRNA sequencing and analysis
description:
Scripts, reference data and an example workflow for rPAL-seq, a method for de novo discovery and profiling of sialic acid modified, glycosylated RNAs (sialoglycoRNAs).

The pipeline covers adapter and UMI trimming (cutadapt), alignment to a curated noncoding RNA reference (bowtie2), UMI-aware expectation-maximization quantification that resolves multi-mapping among near-identical noncoding RNA paralogs, differential enrichment analysis against heat-inactivated-sialidase mock-release controls (DESeq2), and per-base variant signature analysis (samtools mpileup, cpup, limma).

This release accompanies Ge, R. et al., Catch and release of sialoglycoRNAs enables sequencing-based profiling across cellular and extracellular material.
